signals: Connection capacity; transmission build; curtailment; wheeling; grid access; system studies
first_route: Alistair McMaster → project/SEZ technical team → NTCSA
second_route: Nozipho Booi / Mickey Mama if provincial coordination is needed
national_escalation: Monde Bala / Department of Electricity & Energy
why: Define the technical grid constraint first, then escalate policy or programme barriers.

signals: Water allocation; raw water; desalination; WUL; bulk water; municipal water infrastructure
first_route: Alistair McMaster → project/SEZ → relevant municipal/water technical authority
second_route: DEDEAT / OTP if multiple institutions are involved
national_escalation: DWS DG Sean Phillips; Minister only for strategic policy blockage
why: Separate project water demand, resource availability, licensing and infrastructure.

signals: Berth; terminal; storage; marine services; export corridor; port lease; pipelines
national_escalation: TNPA Chief Executive Mohammed Abdool / national Transport
why: Port infrastructure and commercial/authority decisions should be separated from broader transport policy.

signals: Investor query; SEZ proposition; incentive; market entry; investment package
first_route: Siyabulela Lazarus → Nozipho Booi → relevant SEZ/entity
second_route: DEDEAT HoD / MEC for major provincial commitments
why: Keep a single clear investment proposition with project maturity and government ask.

signals: Debt; equity; blended finance; guarantees; project preparation; bankability; risk allocation
national_escalation: DFI executives / Treasury only where systemic public-finance constraints arise
why: Do not route ordinary financing questions straight to Treasury; define transaction need first.

signals: EIA; environmental authorisation; biodiversity; coastal; waste; air quality; permitting sequencing
first_route: Project environmental team → competent authority / DEDEAT environmental function
second_route: Alistair McMaster / DEDEAT coordination if sequencing across approvals is stuck
national_escalation: DFFE DG / Minister for national-level policy or unresolved jurisdictional issue
why: Track each permit separately with legal authority, application status, dependency and decision date.

signals: Land-use; bulk services; municipal electricity; roads; water; zoning; local permits; local economic development
second_route: City Manager → Eastern Cape COGTA / OTP if cross-directorate or IGR blockage
national_escalation: Rare; only after municipal/provincial routes fail
why: Municipal constraints are often implementation problems, so identify the exact directorate and statutory decision.

signals: State land; servitudes; provincial property; enabling infrastructure; implementing agent
first_route: DEDEAT project lead → Eastern Cape DPWI technical route
national_escalation: Only if national land/infrastructure mandate is involved
why: Specify land parcel / asset, infrastructure scope, owner, delivery route and funding source.

signals: SEZ incentive; localisation; manufacturing; value chain; local content; industrial policy
first_route: DEDEAT Investment / Economic Development → Coega or ELIDZ
national_escalation: the dtic Minister / DG / IDC as appropriate
why: Frame the ask as an industrial-development proposition, not simply a hydrogen technology request.

signals: Demonstration; research; electrolyser technology; innovation; skills; university partnership
first_route: Project / provincial sector lead → relevant university / innovation institution
why: Keep technology development separate from permitting and commercial bankability.

signals: Multiple departments; no owner; circular referrals; unresolved municipal/provincial/national issue
first_route: Mickey Mama / DEDEAT HoD with blocker brief
national_escalation: Premier / Presidency only for genuinely strategic unresolved issues
why: Escalate a decision-ready issue, not a general request for help.
